summary: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing its intent to enter into non-redemption agreements with certain shareholders to secure support for a six-month extension of its business combination deadline from May 13, 2026 to November 13, 2026. The registrant, a SPAC, is seeking to avoid liquidation and extend its life to find a target. The filing does not announce a definitive merger or any other special situation; it is a routine procedural step for SPAC maintenance. No deal terms are set. The filing, a SPAC extension solicitation, does not qualify as a special-situations category because no transaction or material change has occurred.
